lines.beaver_en: Hello. Whose portrait would you like?
lines.learner: 부모님 초상화요. 두 분의 용모를 말씀드릴게요.
lines.en: My parents' portrait. I'll describe their looks.
lines.roman: bumonim chosanghwayo. du bunui yongmoreul malsseudeurilgeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Good. What was your father's build like?
lines.en: My father was big and very well-built.

lines.beaver_en: What did his face look like?
lines.en: He was handsome with a high nose. Very fine looks.

lines.beaver_en: How were his expression and eyes?
lines.en: His gaze was sharp, but he never looked angry.

lines.learner: 군복 입은 늠름한 모습으로 그려 주세요.
lines.en: Please paint him looking gallant in uniform.
lines.roman: gunbok ibeun neumneumhan moseubeuro geuryeo juseyo.

lines.beaver_en: I see. What was your mother's build like?
lines.en: My mother was small and slender.
She was always a bit pale, but graceful.

lines.beaver: 외모와 첫인상에 대해 더 말씀해 주시겠습니까?
lines.beaver_en: Could you tell me more about her looks and first impression?
lines.beaver_roman: oemowa cheodinsange daehae deo malsseumhae jusigesseumnikka?
lines.en: She dressed elegantly and always smiled brightly.

lines.beaver_en: How should I do her hair?
lines.learner: 아버지가 빗겨 주시던 단정한 머리로 해 주세요.
lines.en: Please give her the neat hair my father used to comb.
lines.roman: abeojiga bitkkyeo jusideon danjeonghan meoriro hae juseyo.

lines.beaver_en: They were truly loving. I'll paint it with care.
lines.en: Thank you. Please contact me when it's done.
